Plugin.Name: Neoraid
Plugin.Overview: A modern theme for the Unraid 7.3 webGUI that keeps the Unraid palette. Light and dark mode follow Display Settings, with a switch in the navigation bar to change them per browser. Redesigned navigation, tables, forms, dialogs and Dashboard, with Inter as the interface font. Settings → Neoraid sets the accent colour, default mode, density, corners and font, with a live preview. Community Applications, Unassigned Devices, Preclear and ZFS Master get dedicated styles. No system file is changed: removing the plugin restores the stock look.
